evals.prompt: Estructura la feature de facturación (billing) en mi app Expo con Expo Router, con archivos iniciales y su ruta.
evals.expected_output: The agent runs scaffold-feature.mjs billing --with-starter --with-route (first with --dry-run). It creates src/features/billing/ with components, hooks, models, schemas, screens, services and utils, models/billing.ts with its barrel, the screens/billing-home/ screen with a test and index.ts, and a thin route src/app/billing/index.tsx that only re-exports the screen. It does not create an index.ts at the feature root or in components/. The reply is in Spanish.
assertions: Creates the thin route src/app/billing/index.tsx that only re-exports the screen
Does not create index.ts at the feature root or in components/

evals.prompt: Create a modal to create invoices inside the billing feature.
evals.expected_output: The agent uses scaffold-component.mjs create-invoice-modal --target-dir src/features/billing/components --type modal. It generates a component with React Native's Modal and NativeWind, TSDoc, a test with @testing-library/react-native and an index.ts in the leaf folder.

evals.prompt: Review these imports: `import { usePetSearch, IPet } from '@/features/pets';` and `import { InvoiceCard } from '@/features/pets/components';`
evals.expected_output: The agent points out that both import from container folders without a barrel (barrels only in leaf folders) and rewrites them: '@/features/pets/hooks/use-pet-search', '@/features/pets/models' and '@/features/pets/components/invoice-card'. It says to delete any index.ts in container folders.

The agent says routes in src/app/** must be strictly thin, with no useQuery or direct FlatList. It extracts the logic to src/features/billing/ (a useInvoices hook in hooks/use-invoices, a service in services/get-invoices and an InvoicesHome screen in screens/invoices-home) and leaves the route as a one-line adapter: export { InvoicesHome as default } from '@/features/billing/screens/invoices-home'. The reply is in Spanish.
assertions: Says src/app/** routes must be thin
Moves the query into a hook and a service inside the feature
Leaves the route as a one-line re-export of the screen

evals.prompt:
A teammate wrote this in a mobile component: `localStorage.setItem('auth_token', token); const w = window.innerWidth; return
;`
evals.expected_output: The agent points out the critical mobile violations: localStorage does not exist in React Native and must never be used for tokens (use expo-secure-store), window.innerWidth does not exist (use useWindowDimensions or RN's Dimensions), and the DOM elements div/button do not exist (use View and Pressable with accessibilityRole='button').

evals.prompt: Create a mutation hook to register an invoice in the billing feature that invalidates the invoice list.
evals.expected_output: The agent uses scaffold-hook.mjs use-create-invoice --feature billing --kind mutation --entity invoice. It generates the hierarchical invoiceKeys key factory in hooks/invoice-keys with all, lists(), list(filters), details(), detail(id) and the useCreateInvoice hook with useMutation invalidating invoiceKeys.lists().

evals.prompt: I'm in a Turborepo + pnpm monorepo with the mobile app in `apps/mobile`. Structure the orders feature with a starter screen and its route.
evals.expected_output: The agent runs scaffold-feature.mjs orders --target-dir apps/mobile/src/features --app-dir apps/mobile/src/app --with-starter --with-route (using --dry-run first), respecting the mobile architecture inside the monorepo workspace.

evals.prompt: ¿Cómo protejo el grupo de rutas `(app)` en Expo Router para que requiera sesión activa?
evals.expected_output: The agent explains using Stack.Protected (SDK 53+) or a redirect in src/app/(app)/_layout.tsx, consuming the session state from src/features/auth/hooks/use-auth-session and waiting for the secure token hydration from expo-secure-store before redirecting to /(auth)/login. The reply is in Spanish.
assertions: Uses Stack.Protected or a redirect in src/app/(app)/_layout.tsx
Waits for secure token hydration before redirecting

evals.prompt: Set up the standard lint and format tooling for my Expo app with NativeWind and Expo Router.
evals.expected_output: The agent runs or recommends setup-tooling.mjs (with a prior --dry-run) to generate .oxlintrc.json with architectural rules (no-restricted-imports for barrels and thin routes), .oxfmtrc.json with sortTailwindcss: true and jest.config.js with the jest-expo preset and a 90% coverage threshold.

evals.prompt: Structure the billing feature in my Next.js app with the App Router and Server Actions.
evals.expected_output: The agent detects that the request is for Next.js with Server Actions (web) and not for React Native mobile / Expo Router, so it does NOT activate react-native-architecture and defers to nextjs-architecture.
